title: Group in Winter Coats in Snow, 1940s Snapshot B&W Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from around 1947 featuring a group of four women and one man standing together outdoors on a snowy patch of ground. The women wear stylish post-WWII era clothing including fur coats, tailored wool overcoats, hats, and heels, while the man stands in the center wearing a dark coat and fedora hat.
